info.name: V-Pass
info.summary: Zero-knowledge password manager: passwords, passkeys, notes, cards and personal info
info.description:
V-Pass is an end-to-end encrypted password manager for your own Nextcloud.
- Passwords, passkeys, secure notes, credit cards and personal info, organised in folders - Zero-knowledge: everything is encrypted in your browser with your master password. The server only stores ciphertext. - Unlock with your master password or a passkey (WebAuthn PRF), with a recovery key as a backup - Password generator, password health report and breach check (Have I Been Pwned, k-anonymity) - Built-in authenticator (TOTP) codes and encrypted file attachments - Import from NordPass, export to an encrypted backup or CSV
